description: Finsupp.single_eval_le_sum bounds a coefficient without splitting support membership, including zero coefficients outside the support.
Expanding with hasseDeriv_apply before applying the norm bound avoids tracking the image of derivative support.
Finset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_of_nonneg lifts a nonnegative submultiplicative function to finite products, replacing manual insertion induction.
List.ofFn_injective and cancellation of precomposition by a surjective equivalence transport a base-digit sum equality directly to Finsupp equality, removing a bespoke uniqueness wrapper.

Restricting a polynomial submodule to the coefficient field allows Submodule.smul_mem_iff to cancel a nonzero natural scalar in the Hasse-derivative recurrence, avoiding an explicit reciprocal-polynomial identity.
Finset.sum_fn normalizes sums of row functions before application; together with Pi.smul_def it avoids a separate matrix-extensionality equality when using multilinear finite-sum expansion.

AlgHom.map_det with Matrix.map normalization lets terminal simpa transport a finite row determinant expansion through Kronecker substitution, removing a RingHom coercion round-trip and summand congruence.

List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff proves digit bounds directly, avoiding broad simp attempts to synthesize Nonempty for a possibly empty Fin type. Combining it with exact list-index rewrites reduced kroneckerExp_injOn from 1311.73 to 164.75 ms and 6773 to 643 heartbeats.
